description: This PHP class 'Configuration' implements 'ConfigurationInterface' and manages configuration settings for AWS Client Side Monitoring, including properties such as client ID, enabled status, host, and port, with methods for initialization, retrieval, and conversion to array.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class that encapsulates configuration settings for AWS Client Side Monitoring, with methods to set and retrieve properties, and to produce an array representation of the configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Configuration object with specified enabled flag, host, port, and optional client ID, validating and processing inputs.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the configuration object to an associative array.
